== Title ==
<span lang="ja">レッド6</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットを1名追加できる。レッド6に対して「トラブルが発生した」を使用する場合、相手は運命数に2を加えられる。パイロットなしでは戦闘力、回避力、航行速度を使用できない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いでジェック・ポーキンズが搭乗したＸウイング。デス・スター攻撃に使用された。コンピュータと飛行システムの最終点検を受けていない。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Red 6]].

'''Lore''' — X-wing that Jek Porkins flew at the Battle of Yavin. It was used in the Death Star attack. It did not receive the final inspection of its computer and flight systems.

'''Game text''' — May add 1 pilot. When A Problem Occurred is used against Red 6, the opponent may add 2 to destiny. Without a pilot, power, maneuver, and hyperspeed cannot be used.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese lore says the X-wing was used in the Death Star attack, not that it was instrumental in strafing success. Game text adds a must-have-pilot clause absent from the English face. 「トラブルが発生した」 is I've Got A Problem Here. Stats print 回避値; the extra clause prints 回避力.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-red6.gif|Original English face]], [[Red 6]].</ref>
